"""Pure controls for pre-RNA exclusion and pre-acquisition schema admission.

Execute the actual prepare function's AST with explicit inert transaction seams.
The real native-free policy and lease remain in use; no Blender or transport runs.
"""

import ast
import importlib
import json
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PACKAGE = "mcad_assembly_pending_admission_tests"
package = types.ModuleType(PACKAGE)
package.__path__ = [str(ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender")]
sys.modules[PACKAGE] = package
policy = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".operation_contracts")
lease = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".execution_lease")


def trap(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError("Admission reached an unrequested transaction or native seam")


@pytest.fixture
def harness():
    assert not lease.is_busy()
    calls = []
    candidate = json.loads((ROOT / "examples/reused_blocks.mcad-assembly.json").read_text())

    def preflight(value, action):
        calls.append("preflight")
        return policy.result_version_for_assembly(value, action=action)

    state = types.SimpleNamespace(
        _state=lambda context: calls.append("state") or context.scene,
        read_assembly=lambda scene: calls.append("read") or candidate,
        _preflight_assembly=preflight,
        _prepare_report=trap,
        _prepare_operation=trap,
        _recover_report=trap,
        _current_selection=trap,
    )
    namespace = {
        "_main_thread": lambda: calls.append("main_thread"),
        "bridge": types.SimpleNamespace(BridgeError=ValueError),
        "assembly_state": state,
        "execution_lease": lease,
        "_JOB_FACTORY": trap,
        "PendingReport": trap,
        "_ACTIVE": {},
    }
    path = ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_pending.py"
    node = next(
        node
        for node in ast.parse(path.read_bytes()).body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "prepare"
    )
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), namespace)
    yield types.SimpleNamespace(
        prepare=namespace["prepare"],
        namespace=namespace,
        state=state,
        calls=calls,
        candidate=candidate,
    )
    assert not lease.is_busy(), "The test must collect its exact owned lease"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["assembly_check", "assembly_sample"])
def test_busy_foreign_scene_never_reads_rna_or_attempts_acquisition(harness, monkeypatch, action):
    token = lease.try_acquire()
    assert token is not None
    try:
        monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "try_acquire", trap)
        harness.state._state = trap
        harness.state.read_assembly = trap
        harness.state._preflight_assembly = trap
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Another CAD operation"):
            harness.prepare(types.SimpleNamespace(scene=object()), action)
        assert harness.calls == ["main_thread"]
        assert lease.is_busy() and lease._TOKEN is token
        assert not harness.namespace["_ACTIVE"]
    finally:
        assert lease.release(token)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["assembly_check", "assembly_sample"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("unsupported", ["profile_only", "arc_empty"])
def test_free_unsupported_source_rejects_before_acquisition(
    harness, monkeypatch, action, unsupported
):
    path = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/arc_authoring_evidence/radius_edit_5_0_replay.operation.json"
    document = json.loads(path.read_text())["document"]
    if unsupported == "arc_empty":
        document["features"][0]["sketch"]["arcs"] = []
        document["features"][0]["sketch"]["constraints"] = []
        reason = "one schema-3 arc and exactly two radial lines"
    else:
        document["features"] = document["features"][:1]
        document["active_feature"] = document["features"][0]["id"]
        reason = "one sector sketch and one direct extrusion"
    harness.candidate["part_sources"][0]["document"] = document
    before = json.dumps(harness.candidate)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "try_acquire", trap)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=reason):
        harness.prepare(types.SimpleNamespace(scene=object()), action)
    assert harness.calls == ["main_thread", "state", "read", "preflight"]
    assert json.dumps(harness.candidate) == before
    assert not lease.is_busy() and not harness.namespace["_ACTIVE"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["assembly_check", "assembly_sample"])
def test_busy_race_still_rejects_at_atomic_acquisition(harness, monkeypatch, action):
    token = lease.try_acquire()
    real_acquire = lease.try_acquire
    try:
        monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "is_busy", lambda: False)

        def acquire():
            harness.calls.append("acquire")
            return real_acquire()

        monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "try_acquire", acquire)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Another CAD operation"):
            harness.prepare(types.SimpleNamespace(scene=object()), action)
        assert harness.calls == ["main_thread", "state", "read", "preflight", "acquire"]
        assert lease._TOKEN is token and not harness.namespace["_ACTIVE"]
    finally:
        assert lease.release(token)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["assembly_check", "assembly_sample"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["legacy", "sector"])
def test_free_supported_sources_acquire_once_and_release_if_transaction_capture_fails(
    harness, monkeypatch, source, action
):
    if source == "sector":
        path = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/arc_authoring_evidence/radius_edit_5_0_replay.operation.json"
        harness.candidate["part_sources"][0]["document"] = json.loads(path.read_text())["document"]
    assert policy.result_version_for_assembly(harness.candidate, action=action) == (
        3 if source == "sector" else 2
    )
    before = json.dumps(harness.candidate)
    real_acquire, real_release = lease.try_acquire, lease.release
    acquired, released = [], []

    def acquire():
        harness.calls.append("acquire")
        token = real_acquire()
        acquired.append(token)
        return token

    def release(token):
        harness.calls.append("release")
        released.append(token)
        return real_release(token)

    def prepare_report(context, action):
        harness.calls.append("transaction")
        assert lease._TOKEN is acquired[0]
        raise RuntimeError("controlled transaction-capture failure")

    monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "try_acquire", acquire)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "release", release)
    harness.state._prepare_report = prepare_report
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="controlled transaction-capture failure"):
        harness.prepare(types.SimpleNamespace(scene=object()), action)
    assert harness.calls == [
        "main_thread",
        "state",
        "read",
        "preflight",
        "acquire",
        "transaction",
        "release",
    ]
    assert len(acquired) == 1 and acquired[0] is not None
    assert released == acquired and not lease.is_busy()
    assert json.dumps(harness.candidate) == before
